title: Amazon Gets Its Biggest Hit Movie Ever With ‘Project Hail Mary’
body: A decade after it got into the movie business, Amazon has its first major box-office hit.  It’s the biggest-ever debut for a film produced by the e-commerce and cloud-computing giant and the biggest opening for any Hollywood film not part of an existing franchise since “Oppenheimer” in the summer of 2023.
